categories.main_business_segments: Goodwill E-Health Info Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the medical information technology sector, focusing on medical information software development and services. Its main business segments include medical clinical software (electronic medical records, mobile nursing systems, hospital information integration platforms, data centers, intensive care systems, anesthesia systems, specialty electronic medical records for dentistry and obstetrics, ECG information systems, and research information systems), computer hardware and medical devices, and software development and maintenance services for medical information systems. The company also provides regional healthcare solutions such as county medical communities, urban medical groups, and cloud-based electronic medical records platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary core technologies integrating traditional software with next-generation information technologies, including AI, big data, cloud computing, blockchain, and 5G. Key innovations include a large model-assisted electronic medical record automatic generation technology, integrated Chinese and Western medicine clinical decision support, and medical data one-way isolation technology. It employs microservices architecture, containerization, and cloud-native platforms for software development and delivery. The company also develops intelligent clinical decision support systems, medical big data lakehouse platforms, and specialized clinical data governance and mining technologies. R&D is intensive, with a focus on AI-driven smart diagnosis, specialty-specific electronic medical records, and clinical research data platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are medical institutions including hospitals at various levels, research institutions, and government health departments. The company serves over 1,700 hospitals nationwide, including more than 650 top-tier (Class III) hospitals, covering nearly all provinces and regions in China except Taiwan. It also collaborates with regional medical alliances, insurance companies, pharmaceutical enterprises, and internet medical platforms. The end markets focus on clinical healthcare, hospital management, medical research, patient interaction, elderly care integration, and medical payment optimization.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with business coverage extending to all provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions except Taiwan. It has established subsidiaries and branch offices in multiple provinces including Beijing, Tianjin, Chongqing, Guangdong, Hubei, Jiangxi, Jiangsu, Liaoning, Shaanxi, and Xinjiang. Its regional healthcare solutions have been implemented in areas such as Guangdong and Beijing, supporting regional medical consortiums and integrated healthcare networks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Goodwill E-Health Info Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream segment of the healthcare IT supply chain, focusing on software development, system integration, and technology services for medical institutions. It develops proprietary software products and provides technical support and maintenance services, acting as a solution provider and technology enabler rather than a hardware manufacturer or end-user service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing clinical information technology with an emphasis on AI and big data integration to enhance intelligent diagnosis and specialty-specific electronic medical records. It prioritizes R&D in AI-assisted clinical decision support, medical big data governance, and smart hospital construction. The company actively develops large-scale medical AI models, integrates multi-modal data for clinical research, and explores blockchain for secure multi-center clinical studies. It also invests in cloud-native architectures and microservices to improve product scalability and deployment efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of self-developed medical software products, software development and technical support services, and sales of computer hardware and medical devices. The company also earns income from paid maintenance services and project-based implementation contracts. Sales are conducted via direct bidding and procurement by medical institutions and indirect sales through third-party non-medical organizations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the electronic medical records (EMR) market, holding the top market share in China for ten consecutive years according to IDC reports. It ranks among the top three in the medical big data solutions market. Its competitors include other domestic medical IT providers, but Goodwill maintains a competitive edge through its early market entry, extensive hospital client base, and advanced AI-driven clinical solutions. It is also a participant in national standards development, reinforcing its industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 591.9 million, a 14.85% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 256.1 million. The company experienced a decline in profitability due to delayed customer demand, extended project delivery cycles, increased asset impairment provisions, and sustained high R&D investments. Total assets stood at approximately RMB 2.49 billion with net assets of RMB 1.56 billion. Despite short-term losses, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D, with R&D expenses accounting for 37.59% of revenue in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Goodwill E-Health emphasizes its proprietary core technologies and deep integration of AI and big data to deliver intelligent, specialty-focused clinical information systems. Its products offer advanced features such as AI-assisted electronic medical record generation, integrated Chinese and Western medicine decision support, and comprehensive clinical data governance. The company’s solutions are designed to improve clinical efficiency, enhance medical quality, and support high-level research and hospital management. Its long-standing market leadership, extensive hospital network, and participation in national standards development further differentiate its offerings.
